title: Felix and the Sigil Anew
author: Beatrix Eastwick
blurb: Oscar Iversen, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
